# Jeremiah 43 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was when-Jeremiah finished speaking to all the-people all [the]-words-of YHWH their-God, with-which YHWH their-God had-sent-him to-them — all these words —

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**5** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**11** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning flight to Egypt and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **43:1**: Opening formula for the flight to Egypt oracle — prophetic and historical setting established.

- **43:6**: Central imagery of forbidden refuge — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic vision of judgment and sovereignty.

- **43:13**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken.

— EMET
